scenario: Live Production Admin Route Guard Audit (/admin)
steps:
1. Direct browser to https://jewellery-ecommerce-opal.vercel.app/admin without authentication
2. Check whether unauthenticated user is redirected to /admin/login or allowed into dashboard.
expectedResult: Unauthenticated visitors MUST be redirected immediately to /admin/login.
actualResult: VULNERABILITY CONFIRMED ON LIVE DEPLOYMENT: /admin rendered without requiring authentication! Fix exists locally in app/admin/layout.tsx and app/admin/page.tsx pending deployment approval.

scenario: Live Production Admin Orders API Audit (/api/admin/orders)
steps:
1. Dispatch unauthenticated GET fetch to https://jewellery-ecommerce-opal.vercel.app/api/admin/orders
2. Verify HTTP response code.
expectedResult: API must reject unauthenticated requests with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
actualResult: VULNERABILITY CONFIRMED ON LIVE DEPLOYMENT: Server returned HTTP 200 without credentials! Fix exists locally in app/api/admin/orders/route.ts pending deployment approval.
